world.scenario: A storm has trapped a group of guests in a crumbling manor, where a long-buried murder has resurfaced. The house is a labyrinth of guilt, hidden secrets, and a killer who still walks its halls. Every room holds a clue to the past, but also a barrier to the future — and the only way out is to uncover the truth before the killer strikes again.
world.objective: Uncover the identity of the murderer and prevent their next victim from being killed.

rooms.description: The air is thick with the scent of damp wood and old perfume, as if the house still clings to the memories of those who once lived here. Flickering sconces cast jagged shadows across the cracked marble floor, revealing faint scuff marks that seem to lead deeper into the mansion.
rooms.goal: Discover the hidden passage behind the ornate mirror and unlock the foyer entrance.

rooms.description: The scent of burnt tea and aged leather fills the air, mingling with the musty odor of forgotten books. A candelabra sits on a side table, its candles long melted, leaving only smears of wax and the faint smell of smoke.
rooms.goal: Solve the cipher on the bookshelf to reveal the location of a hidden key and unlock the parlor door.

rooms.description: The scent of ink and decay lingers in the air, as if the room itself has been writing its own tragic tale. Faint traces of blood are visible on the wooden floorboards, and the flickering light of a single hanging bulb reveals a portrait that seems to watch the intruder with hollow eyes.
rooms.goal: Use the hidden key to unlock the desk and retrieve the diary of the missing guest, then unlock the study door.

rooms.description: Dusty tomes and the faint whisper of turning pages create an eerie atmosphere, as if the books themselves are speaking in hushed tones. The scent of old paper and lavender lingers in the air, mixing with the musty dampness that seeps through the cracks in the floor.
rooms.goal: Decipher the diary to uncover the name of the murderer and the location of the final clue, then unlock the library door.

rooms.description: A cold draft whistles through the broken boards of the attic floor, carrying the scent of rust and decay. The faint echo of footsteps seems to come from nowhere, and the wooden planks beneath your feet creak as if the house is warning you of what lies ahead.
